 About Karat 

We're building the one-stop shop for creator finances. 

Your favorite digital creators—the ones you follow every day on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok or Twitch—aren’t just extraordinarily talented personalities and community builders. They’re also businesses. That means they have business needs—managing revenues, expenses, savings, credit, and banking. We’re building products that help creators spend less time worrying about finances so they can focus on creating. 

 About the Role 

We’re looking for a Product Engineer to help us build the smallest, smartest back office in fintech. 

At Karat, we believe great internal systems — powered by automation, AI, and thoughtful UX — can replace layers of manual ops. This is a high-leverage, highly autonomous role for someone who loves building internal tools that feel like magic: fast, reliable, and deeply impactful. 

You’ll own and evolve the systems that power our operations, support, risk, and compliance teams — from admin dashboards and Slack bots to real-time notifications and AI-assisted workflows. Your work will directly enable Karat to scale efficiently without adding headcount. 

You’ll partner closely with product, ops, risk, and engineering to identify friction, automate workflows, and build internal platforms that set the gold standard for operational excellence. 

This position is based in Los Angeles, CA. 

The compensation for this role is between $130k to $170k. 

 What you’ll do: 
 

Design and build internal tools used daily by operations, support, and risk teams 

Create automation for key workflows — onboarding, approvals, limits, escalations, and more 

Build AI-powered workflows with humans-in-the-loop to increase team leverage 

Develop admin dashboards, Slack bots, and real-time notification systems 

Partner cross-functionally to identify pain points and solve them with software 

Maintain high reliability, performance, and usability across all internal systems 

Continuously look for opportunities to eliminate manual work and improve operational scale 

Jump into high-priority problems wherever leverage is highest 
 

 What you'll need: 
 

1-3+ years of experience as a software engineer, product engineer, or technical generalist 

Strong coding skills in JavaScript/TypeScript (React + Node preferred) 

Comfort working across the stack and owning products end-to-end 

Experience building internal tools, automation systems, or operational platforms 

Excitement about shipping practical AI/LLM use cases that drive real outcomes 

Strong product intuition and bias toward impact and speed 

Ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-trust environments 

FinTech experience is preferred but not required

 Why Karat? 
 

 Huge opportunity. The creator economy just flew past a $50b milestone despite zero infra for creator banking. It’s our race to lose.
